thesis: The speaker argues that the traditional belief that following rules and climbing a ladder guarantees success is a flawed prescription that failed him, leading to a marriage failure and a crisis of identity. He describes slipping into a new way of thinking that recognizes a world beyond simple binaries of right and wrong, good and bad, and you and me.
